verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a desktop/terminal AI coding workbench, but nothing in the evidence documents a telemetry or usage-tracking setting, flag, or environment variable. The listed env vars cover provider config and the data directory only. Community reports of silent workspace uploads, and suggestions to sandbox the app or run it under a separate user account, are user-side workarounds and are not a product opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
